question: The Müller cells of the retina are:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Müller cells are neuroglial cells -> Provide structural support to the retina -> Assist in maintaining the blood-retinal barrier -> 85% confidence. enhanced_information: Müller cells of the retina are neuroglial cells of support that provide structural support and assist in maintaining the blood-retinal barrier.
